items.title: Logitech Gives 7,000 Staff a Day Off to Play Video Games Ahead of ‘GTA 6’
items.summary: Logitech is giving 7,000 employees a dedicated day off to play video games, including GTA 6, as part of its Logi Game Day employee benefit.

items.title: GTA 6 could get FSR 4.1 support on Xbox Series X|S to compete with PSSR on PS5 Pro
items.summary: GTA 6 has been confirmed to get support for PSSR on the PS5 Pro, though the exact version is unclear. A new report has suggested that the game could come with some upscaling technology on the Xbox Series consoles as well.

items.title: 'GTA 6' Preload and Launch: Date, Size, Price and Platforms
items.summary: GTA 6 preload opened Nov. 10 and needs up to 212 GB. Here are the launch date, prices, platforms and what to know before Nov. 19.

items.title: Rockstar Confirms GTA 6 Will Run at 30fps On All Consoles - IGN Daily Fix
